svg.title: ACT device: representative application diagram
svg.desc: Fresh or citrated whole blood, as stated in the cuvette IFU, is applied to the appropriate cartridge in the correct volume; sample time and heparin context are recorded. Not an exact drawing of electrode or catheter placement.
svg.text: Application to the patient — general placement
Fresh or citrated whole blood, as stated in the cuvette IFU, is applied to the appropriate cartridge in
the correct volume; sample time and heparin context are recorded.
REPRESENTATIVE DIAGRAM • Not a device photo. For exact placement use the current IFU for the model and sensor.
